prompt: Build the Iron Throne from Game of Thrones — a massive jagged throne built from hundreds of MELTED SWORDS fused together. Its unmistakable features: (1) a wide imposing chair silhouette with a high back that rises into a chaotic spiky CROWN of sword blades pointing upward and outward at all angles, (2) the entire structure is made of fused interlocking sword blades (long thin diagonal STONE/COBBLE shapes radiating outward), (3) wide arm rests bristling with more sword tips, (4) standing on a low stone dais. The throne is grey-black metal, dark and forbidding. Use STONE and COBBLE for the bulk of the fused sword body, OAK_LOG for darker recessed shadows between blades, BRICK for hilts and pommels (slightly red-brown accents), SAND for the few brighter polished blade edges and the dais stone. The crown of swords rising above the seat back is the iconic identifier — make those sword tips long, jagged, and asymmetric, jutting outward at varied angles like a thorny iron crown. Position it facing the viewer with a clear seat opening between the sword-tip arm rests. Make it imposing — taller than wide at the top. Use the full budget for layered sword detail.
